additions.title: Beyond the Label - LASALLE Booth Facilitators (21 October 2026)
additions.description: Support a mental health awareness booth at LASALLE on 21 October, 10am-3pm. Facilitate activities and talk with visitors; briefing is provided before the shift.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. Confident English communication and willingness to engage strangers. Commit to the full shift; long trousers and covered shoes required.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. Confident English communication and willingness to engage strangers. Commit to the full shift; long trousers and covered shoes required.
discovery.notes: Official page checked. Application deadline is unspecified; event dates are not application deadlines. Availability remains subject to organiser confirmation.

additions.title: Deepavali Home Cleaning - Marsiling Home Refreshers 2026
additions.description: Help seniors clean their homes ahead of Deepavali on 24 October, 9am-1pm. Attend compulsory online onboarding on 22 October at 7pm and bring the listed cleaning supplies.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. Comfortable doing household chores. Compulsory onboarding and one cleaning session. Bring rags, detergent, disposable gloves and a pail.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. Comfortable doing household chores. Compulsory onboarding and one cleaning session. Bring rags, detergent, disposable gloves and a pail.
discovery.notes: Official page checked. Application deadline is unspecified; event dates are not application deadlines. Availability remains subject to organiser confirmation.

additions.location: Marina Bay Sands Bayfront Event Space, Singapore
additions.title: Beyond the Label - Marina Bay Sands Booth Facilitators 2026
additions.description: Facilitate mental health awareness activities and conversations at Marina Bay Sands from 23-25 October. Choose at least one shift; on-site briefing is provided.
additions.eligibility: Age 18+. Confident English communication and willingness to engage strangers. Commit to at least one shift. Long trousers and covered shoes required.

discovery.restrictions: Age 18+. Confident English communication and willingness to engage strangers. Commit to at least one shift. Long trousers and covered shoes required.
discovery.notes: Official page checked. Application deadline is unspecified; event dates are not application deadlines. Availability remains subject to organiser confirmation.

additions.title: Woodlands Christmas Carnival 2026 - Operational Volunteers
additions.description: Assist with games, ushering, food distribution and crowd management at a family carnival on 5 December, 3.30pm-9pm, at Fuchun Primary School.
additions.eligibility: Age 15+. Able to stand for extended periods. Attend online briefing on 30 November or 2 December, 7pm-8pm, and the full event shift.

discovery.restrictions: Age 15+. Able to stand for extended periods. Attend online briefing on 30 November or 2 December, 7pm-8pm, and the full event shift.
discovery.notes: Official page checked. Application deadline is unspecified; event dates are not application deadlines. Availability remains subject to organiser confirmation.

additions.title: Young Hearts - Tutor Aide, Buddy Mentor and Event Befriender
additions.description: Support children through academic coaching, weekly mentoring or activities at occasional events. Register through the SRC volunteer portal to explore roles and training.
additions.eligibility: Role-specific age and suitability requirements must be confirmed with the organiser. Weekly tutor and mentor roles require regular commitment.

discovery.restrictions: Role-specific age and suitability requirements must be confirmed with the organiser. Weekly tutor and mentor roles require regular commitment.
discovery.notes: The beneficiary age range is not a volunteer age requirement. Portal registration does not guarantee placement.

additions.title: MINDS - Service and Event Volunteering
additions.description: Support people with intellectual disabilities through befriending, community activities and event logistics. Register interest with MINDS for matching to suitable roles.
additions.eligibility: No prior experience is needed for general volunteering. Student age, screening and commitment requirements depend on the role and should be confirmed with MINDS.

discovery.restrictions: No prior experience is needed for general volunteering. Student age, screening and commitment requirements depend on the role and should be confirmed with MINDS.
discovery.notes: Official page links to registration, but the external form returned an access restriction during research. Deadline is unspecified.

additions.title: UnLitter Red Dot - School and Community Group Clean-ups
additions.description: Arrange a group litter-picking session with equipment and briefing provided. School group sessions run on Fridays, 3pm-5pm, in Aljunied; book at least six weeks ahead.
additions.eligibility: Family and child-friendly programme for groups of 20-200. School and corporate bookings require donation support. Enquire by email with group size and preferred dates.

discovery.fees: Donation support required for group volunteering; confirm amount with organiser.
discovery.restrictions: Family and child-friendly programme for groups of 20-200. School and corporate bookings require donation support. Enquire by email with group size and preferred dates.
discovery.notes: Enquiry-based group opportunity. Email info@habitat.org.sg using instructions on the source page. Donation amount is unspecified; individual slots are not confirmed.

additions.title: NLB - Library and Archives Volunteer Registration
additions.description: Register as an NLB volunteer and select preferred libraries, interests and locations. Student volunteers can supply school details; placements depend on available activities.
additions.eligibility: Applicants under 13 must be accompanied by a caregiver who is also registered. Role-specific age and participation requirements may apply.

discovery.restrictions: Applicants under 13 must be accompanied by a caregiver who is also registered. Role-specific age and participation requirements may apply.
discovery.notes: Volunteer registration route, not a guaranteed event vacancy. No numeric minimum age was inferred from the caregiver rule.

additions.title: SOS CareText - Service-based Volunteer
additions.description: Train to offer confidential emotional support through CareText. Applications are accepted throughout the year; shortlisted applicants attend briefings, interviews and supervised training.
additions.eligibility: CareText applicants must be 18+, proficient in English and text messaging, emotionally mature and willing to maintain confidentiality. Commit 3-4 hours weekly, one overnight monthly and at least one year after training. Hours cannot count towards practicum.

discovery.restrictions: CareText applicants must be 18+, proficient in English and text messaging, emotionally mature and willing to maintain confidentiality. Commit 3-4 hours weekly, one overnight monthly and at least one year after training. Hours cannot count towards practicum.
discovery.notes: This listing covers CareText only. Hotline volunteering requires age 23+ and two years of commitment. Training and volunteering take place at the SOS office.
